findings.namedBuyers: Aaron West, President, and Mike Marino, VP, Sales & Business Development, are verified organizer leadership contacts. Their relevance is inferred as executive routing and commercial partnership routing respectively; neither is verified as a hotel contracting buyer.
findings.futureEdition: none announced. No organizer-announced Toronto edition on or after 2026-12-07 was found. The official Toronto homepage still identifies September 24–25, 2026, and its registration page is titled for 2026. Cantonfair lists September 16–17, 2027 at MaRS Centre with an organizer-verification warning. A separate Blue Collar Investor calendar lists September 23–24, 2027, with details and registration link to follow and no venue. Neither establishes an official next edition; the conflicting dates must not be qualified.
findings.venueCommitments: No future venue commitment verified. MaRS Centre, 101 College St, Toronto, Ontario, Canada, is verified only for the historical September 24–25, 2026 edition.
findings.accommodationSourcing: hotel_sourcing_unconfirmed. The organizer’s undated hotel page names The Chelsea Hotel, Toronto; it does not establish a 2027 block, sourcing window, rates or availability.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Ask the organizer to confirm in writing whether a Toronto edition after 2026-12-07 is announced, its exact dates and contracted venue, and who handles accommodation procurement. Explicitly reconcile the September 16–17 versus September 23–24, 2027 listings. Do not quote a dated hotel block until confirmed.
